children: Crédit Agricole owns 30% of Banco BPM, which faces a takeover offer from €35 bln Monte dei Paschi. If the Gallic group resists, the latter may fall to Intesa Sanpaolo. CrédAg CEO Olivier Gavalda could extract a juicy premium, or even do some Milanese-style dealmaking of his own.
Full view will be published shortly.

Banca Monte dei Paschi di Siena (MPS) on August 21 announced a tender offer for Banco BPM. MPS offered 1.567 of its own shares for each BPM share, valuing the rival bank at 16.3 euros, after factoring in a special dividend. Crédit Agricole owns 29.3% of Banco BPM stock.
